src.title: Trump proposes new tariffs on China, EU and 12 other partners

dossier.headline: US proposes new tariffs on 14 partners, up to 25% on India
dossier.summary: Reports on 25 Nov morning said the US was close to a fresh wave of tariffs to replace those struck down by the Supreme Court. That evening the administration proposed rates of 17% on India with a trade deal or 25% without, 20% on China and 15% on the EU, with no levy possible before January 2027 because of public hearings.
why_it_matters: India is directly named, and its rate depends on reaching a trade deal
The plan covers 14 trading partners, including China and the EU
watch: India's response and progress on a trade deal
Public hearings ahead of any January 2027 start
